title: ruby: $stdout switched to $stderr is a different stream, never a rename
kotlin: a call switched to a new helper with other logic (old helper deleted) is not a rename
swift: closure parameters that swapped places are other parameters, not renames
swift: a bool renamed to its negation (`!` dropped, callers compare to false) means the opposite: no rename
kotlin: a field now built from another class (NetworkObserver -> SystemCallbacks) was replaced, not renamed
kotlin: a boolean parameter renamed and given a default (`= false`) is still a rename, not a negation
kotlin: a method renamed whose block body became an expression body is still a rename
ruby: a parameter renamed inside its method is still a rename
old:
class Cart
  def total(items)
    sum = 0
    items.each { |i| sum += i.price }
    sum + items.size
  end
end
new:
class Cart
  def total(entries)
    sum = 0
    entries.each { |i| sum += i.price }
    sum + entries.size
  end
end

title: kotlin: a helper renamed with its body unchanged and its callers updated is still a rename
swift: closure parameters renamed in place are still renames
kotlin: a field renamed together with the class it is built from is still a rename
swift: a bool renamed with every use unchanged is still a rename
